title: Chocolate bar in the canopy understory

tokens.v: WIDE — set it small on the mossed root in the lower third, buttress roots and hanging vine rising past the top edge; disregard every mid-shot, subject-filling-frame and glass-jar-of-body-butter instruction elsewhere in this brief, since the object on the root is the referenced product itself. 28mm at f/2.8, camera low on the forest floor, mist banding through the depth behind. A drip has just left a leaf tip and struck the wrapper, darkening one patch of fibre. A wet fern frond crosses the near foreground out of focus, cut by the bottom-left edge.
